title: Does the FARNet neural network algorithm accurately identify Posteroanterior cephalometric landmarks?
summary: FARNet detects 47 cephalometric landmarks on 1,431 PA radiographs with a train/validation/test split; pointwise errors vary, from 0.94-mm right-gonion MRE to 3.31-mm right-condylon MRE, and performance is compared with a human expert. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.
